purpose: A bounded numerical search for additional low-degree SO(3)-invariant first-integral candidates after value identities and the represented algebra of constants, H, H^2, and |L|^2 are removed.
evidence_boundary: A no-candidate result excludes only the frozen degree-two primitive library and mass-parameter blocks on the frozen development/calibration corpus at the declared thresholds. A numerical candidate does not authorize physical interpretation, a conservation claim, or opening the sealed publication reserve; it only triggers a separately frozen candidate qualification.

staged_policy.SEARCH_READY: Requires both prerequisite qualification records, an intact sealed reserve, and machine-precision behavior of the represented known algebra.
staged_policy.CANDIDATE_READY: Requires every frozen numerical candidate threshold; no semantic interpretation is authorized.
staged_policy.PUBLICATION_READY: Requires a separate candidate-specific lock, covariance and gauge falsification, independence and Poisson tests, variational and long-time tests, sealed-reserve execution, and independent replication. It is blocked in this campaign.
